#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Gate 1 for a round_config.json round (stdlib only; no network, no model calls in this round).

Gate 1 is the automated check the brief describes: recommendations are verified against predictions recorded before
the round fired. Predictions are deferred for round 8, so with no <round-dir>/predictions.jsonl gate 1 still runs,
does the mechanical checks below, and reports "no predictions this round" (it does not fail).

Per landed reply (primary {model}.md and cross-review {model}_teamwork.md), current runs only:
  hold  truncated          check_detail says TRUNCATED (finish was a truncation/error stop, or no finish recorded)
  hold  stale_run          check_detail says STALE
  hold  misidentified      land() refused the reply (landing_refusals.jsonl), so nothing landed for it
  hold  turn_cap_reached   the reply's tool loop hit tool_max_turns / tool_max_calls (flow_log cap_event)
  hold  budget_stop        one of the reply's requests ended in budget_stop, or the runner stopped before a model
                           call because round_budget_usd (the round total) was reached (flow_log budget_event;
                           nothing landed for that reply)
  hold  gate1_refused      predictions.jsonl changed after the primary run fired (sha256 differs from run.json)
  hold  gate1_unverifiable predictions are present but the verification step is not built (round 8: deferred)
  flag  first_step_failure the reply's first request was not a read of a context_first_docs document (D10: flag only,
                           never holds)
The answered_by trace (D9: Claude Code both answers questions and is one of the reviewers; the conflict is accepted
and made visible) counts, per model, the answers that came from Claude Code and the decisions it delivered.

Writes <round-dir>/gate1/{summary.md,items.jsonl,gaps.jsonl}; an existing file is moved to gate1/archive/ as _revN
first (never overwritten, never deleted).
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
import sys
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import land_review_reply as lr  # noqa: E402
import round_config as rc  # noqa: E402

PREDICTIONS = "predictions.jsonl"
NO_PREDICTIONS = "no predictions this round"
REQUEST_TOOLS = ("read_doc", "request_info", "ask_claude_code")
HOLD_ORDER = ("misidentified", "stale_run", "truncated", "gate1_refused", "gate1_unverifiable", "budget_stop",
              "turn_cap_reached")


def read_jsonl(path: Path) -> list[dict]:
    if not Path(path).is_file():
        return []
    out = []
    for line in Path(path).read_text().splitlines():
        line = line.strip()
        if line:
            try:
                out.append(json.loads(line))
            except json.JSONDecodeError:
                out.append({"_unreadable": line[:200]})
    return out


def write_new(path: Path, text: str) -> Path:
    """Write text to path; an existing different file is first moved to <dir>/archive/<stem>_revN<suffix>."""

  python scripts/ledger.py ingest  --dir <artifact dir> --ref <artifact name> [--run-id N]
      (receipt artifacts are accepted only inside the ledger workflow: RUN_WORKFLOW_PATH/RUN_HEAD_SHA from the
       producing run + a verified artifact attestation; anywhere else they are refused)
  python scripts/ledger.py backfill [--artifacts <dir of unzipped artifacts>]   # reviews/*_round*/ + artifacts
  python scripts/ledger.py mirror  [--apply] [--min-severity major] [--cap 5] [--only-ids a,b]   # dry-run unless --apply
  python scripts/ledger.py status  --issue N --state closed --reason completed|not_planned [--labels a,b]
  python scripts/ledger.py append-file --file <records.jsonl>
  python scripts/ledger.py ingest-staged [--dir ledger/pending] [--dry-run]
      (v1.2: Danny's staged decisions -> finding + status records. Writes only inside the ledger workflow on main,
       GITHUB_ACTIONS=true and GITHUB_REF=refs/heads/main; anywhere else it refuses unless --dry-run)
  python scripts/ledger.py validate            # schema + receipt digests (evidence unaltered)
  python scripts/ledger.py classify-legacy     # v1.1: tag pre-gate findings/costs review_class=legacy
  python scripts/ledger.py verify-append-only --old <file> --new <file>

Mirror (issue filing) needs GITHUB_TOKEN + GITHUB_REPOSITORY; dry-run prints what it would file and posts nothing.
Every title/body is sanitised and re-checked for trigger strings and at-mentions before posting.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import datetime as dt
import json
import os
import sys
import urllib.error
import urllib.request
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import ledger_lib as L  # noqa: E402

API = "https://api.github.com"


def ledger_path(cfg) -> Path:
    return L.ROOT / cfg["ledger_path"]


# ------------------------------------------------------------------ GitHub REST (injectable for tests)
class GitHub:
    def __init__(self, repo: str, token: str, opener=None):
        self.repo, self.token, self.opener = repo, token, opener or urllib.request.urlopen

    def req(self, method, path, body=None):
        r = urllib.request.Request(API + path, method=method, data=None if body is None else json.dumps(body).encode(),
                                   headers={"authorization": f"Bearer {self.token}", "accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
                                            "x-github-api-version": "2022-11-28", "content-type": "application/json"})
        with self.opener(r, timeout=30) as resp:
            txt = resp.read().decode()
            return json.loads(txt) if txt else {}

    def ensure_label(self, name, color="ededed"):
        try:
            self.req("POST", f"/repos/{self.repo}/labels", {"name": name, "color": color})
        except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
            if e.code != 422:          # 422 = already exists
                raise

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Reviewer scoring (issue #8): planted-mistake precision/recall + status-based scorecards from the ledger.

  python scripts/ledger_score.py offline                     # default: score what is already in the ledger, no calls
  python scripts/ledger_score.py render --out <file>          # write the rendered planted fixture (for inspection)
  python scripts/ledger_score.py score-verdict --reviewer kimi --verdict <verdict.json> [--append]
  python scripts/ledger_score.py planted-live --reviewers kimi,deepseek --confirm spend   # PAID: dispatch only

Planted run: the fixture (ledger/planted/<v>/template.md, retired items as {{RETIRED:n}} placeholders) is rendered
into a throwaway local commit; the normal reviewer scripts (scripts/review_<name>.py, unchanged) review that commit;
their findings are matched against keys.json. Precision = matched findings / (matched + unmatched non-note findings);
recall = keys caught / keys planted. Outputs: ledger/scorecards.json and ledger/scorecards.md.
"""
from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import json
import os
import re
import shutil
import subprocess
import sys
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(__file__))
import ledger_lib as L  # noqa: E402

FIXTURE = L.ROOT / "ledger" / "planted" / "v1"
RETIRED_FILE = L.ROOT / "harness" / "retired.txt"


def retired_entries(path: Path = RETIRED_FILE) -> list[tuple[str, str]]:
    out = []
    for line in path.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines():
        if line.strip() and not line.lstrip().startswith("#"):
            label, pat, _ = [p.strip() for p in line.split(" | ", 2)]
            out.append((label, pat))
    return out


def render_fixture(fixture: Path = FIXTURE, retired=None) -> str:
    retired = retired or retired_entries()
    return re.sub(r"\{\{RETIRED:(\d+)\}\}", lambda m: retired[int(m.group(1))][0].split("(")[0].strip(),
                  (fixture / "template.md").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def load_keys(fixture: Path = FIXTURE) -> dict:
    return json.loads((fixture / "keys.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))


def key_patterns(key: dict, retired) -> list[re.Pattern]:
    pats = list(key.get("match") or [])
    if key["category"] == "retired":
        pats.append(retired[key["retired_index"]][1])
    pats.append(rf"\b(line|item|point) {key['line']}\b")
    return [re.compile(p, re.I | re.M) for p in pats]
